title: Structure-Aware Spatial Kernels for Gaussian Process Distributed Port-Hamiltonian Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian systems (GP-dPHS) enable data-driven modeling of distributed dynamical systems while preserving their physical structure. However, standard stationary kernels can be inefficient for spatially heterogeneous systems because they neither exploit known input invariances nor reflect structured spatial dependencies. We address this limitation with a structure-aware kernel design that removes irrelevant state coordinates and decouples state and spatial dependencies through a tensor-product covariance. This modular construction allows qualitative knowledge of spatial heterogeneity to be incorporated by selecting an appropriate spatial kernel without requiring an analytical description of the underlying profile. translated_title: 面向高斯过程分布式端口哈密顿系统的结构感知空间核
translated_abstract: 高斯过程分布式端口哈密顿系统（GP-dPHS）能够在保持物理结构的同时，实现对分布式动力系统的数据驱动建模。然而，标准的平稳核在处理空间异质系统时可能效率低下，因为它们既无法利用已知的输入不变性，也无法反映结构化的空间依赖关系。我们通过一种结构感知的核设计来解决这一局限：该设计去除了不相关的状态坐标，并通过张量积协方差将状态依赖与空间依赖解耦。这种模块化构建方式使得可以通过选择合适的空间核来融入关于空间异质性的定性知识，而无需对底层剖面进行解析描述。在具有周期性、平滑变化和半分段刚度剖面的非线性弦上进行的数值实验表明，结构解耦能够持续改善重建精度……
tldr: 提出一种结构感知的核设计，通过张量积协方差将状态与空间依赖解耦，使高斯过程分布式端口哈密顿系统能够高效建模空间异质系统并融入定性空间知识。
en_tdlr: A structure-aware kernel design that decouples state and spatial dependencies via tensor-product covariance enables efficient modeling of spatially heterogeneous systems in Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian frameworks.
